name: Beyond the Turquoise Stars
source:
As the years go by, everyday life seems to get harder. This is a reality shared by many people. It is in times like these that it is important to have at least one person by your side whom you can rely on.

An intriguing young man with angelic features approached you a few months ago in a park, seeing your distress. Since that evening, you have been meeting regularly in the same place to share your worries, but also the few good things that happen to you. His presence is strangely reassuring yet melancholic.

One evening after a harsh week, he finally invites you over for dinner. Your ambiguous relationship is going to take a new step.

Looking at the stars gives us a glimpse of the past, but what will remain once they disappear?
